title: Online Yoga from Home | Yoga Momente Coburg
description: Online yoga with Susanne Müller: individual classes, meditation and yoga nidra by video call, comfortably from home.

sections.title: Online yoga
sections.lead: Get your yoga mat out and join the virtual class, comfortably from home.

sections.title: How your virtual class works.
paragraphs: I offer very individual yoga classes as well as relaxation with meditation or yoga nidra via a virtual medium from my yoga studio in Coburg. If you have the right technology at home, that is a PC with a camera, an iPad or a phone, we can meet virtually.
You receive access to a platform, for example Zoom, for your yoga class. Simply log in, position the video properly and off you go. I am happy to help you set up your virtual yoga class by phone.
All of my classes can also be booked virtually.
Take care of your health, take forest baths and enjoy nature. And do not forget: yoga does not only happen on the mat!

sections.title: What you need for this class
list: A quiet place to retreat to
At least 60 minutes of phone-free time
A comfortable surface and your yoga mat

sections.title: Sign up now and secure your place!
sections.text: The price per class varies depending on the type of class. Talk to me and I will gladly advise you which class suits you best.
